preconditions.description: The input s must be a string.
The input string s must not be empty.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() and c.isalpha() for c in s)
preconditions.description: The input string s must contain only lowercase alphabetic characters.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: The output string must contain only lowercase alphabetic characters.
The length of the output string must be the same as the input string.
The output string must be the result of applying the vowel_back function to each character in the input string.
